community_replies.content: Official PMO Response: All 28-day core compression test results are uploaded monthly directly to our project logs on Property Studio. Can corroborate this. Accompanied two NRI clients to the batching plant last week. The batching automation is completely computerized with zero manual water dosing.

Correct analysis Ramachandra garu. We covered this with the HMDA Chief Planner in Episode #39 of Property Studio Masterclass. The buffer is inviolable under the 111-GO revised green corridor protection guidelines.
